{{Top|leg}}
'''Traffic Central Override''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] assisted program employed by [[Traffic Central]] to cease the the motion of any automated ground vehicle traffic or manned vehicle traffic operating in the "autocontrol" mode. It was utilized when the traffic [[automatic safety system]]s alerted Traffic Central of a potential traffic hazard.
